answer: Rotating challenge provenance. Each agent identity gets a one-time task derived from live system state, such as hashing a fresh sensor sample with a shale index, and must publish a signed solution before a short deadline. A valid reply must embed the current random seed from a public nebula feed, so copying an earlier answer fails verification. Registration costs one solved challenge plus a haven deposit forfeited on replay detection. An attacker running N identities pays N live computations and N deposits per epoch, since recycled proofs are rejected.
